## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person/Contact** — core entity; has Name, Agent (assigned), Created (date), Stage, Source, Last Visit, Pages Viewed, Properties Viewed, Properties Saved, Last Communication (datetime), Calls Made
- **Smart List** — entity with ID (30), name, description, type ("PIPELINE" badge = belongs to a Pipeline collection), filter set
- **Collection** — grouping entity (e.g., "Pipeline") containing multiple smart lists
- **Tag** — string values attached to a Person; support namespaced format (`namespace:value`), snake_case (`do_not_text`), ALL_CAPS (`NOTEXT`), and PascalCase/plain (`Bounced`, `Realtor`)
- **Agent** — user/broker assigned to a contact
- **Stage** — pipeline stage value; at least one stage named "B - Warm..." exists (starts with "B -" suggesting alphabetic prefix ordering like A, B, C... for stage tiers)
- **Segment / Saved View** — "Out Of State Home..." is a named segment that can be applied as an additional filter layer to any list view

### Fields / Column Data Model
| Field | Data Type | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| Name | String | Person's full name |
| Agent | String / FK → User | Assigned broker/agent |
| Created | DateTime | When the contact was created in FUB |
| Stage | Enum / FK → Stage | Pipeline stage; sortable |
| Source | String / Enum | Lead source |
| Last Visit | DateTime | Last website visit timestamp |
| Pages Viewed | Integer | Count of pages viewed on IDX/website |
| Properties Viewed | Integer | Count of property listings viewed |
| Properties Saved | Integer | Count of saved/favorited properties |
| Last Communication | DateTime | Most recent manual call/text/email; sortable |
| Calls Made | Integer | Total call count |

### Filter Field Types Revealed
- **Tags**: multi-value string set; supports "are not empty" / "include any" / "exclude any|all" / "are empty" operators
- **Last Text Sent**: DateTime; supports "more than N days ago" operator
- **Last Sent Email**: DateTime; supports "more than N days ago" operator
- **Last Call**: DateTime; supports "more than N days ago" operator
- **Stage**: Enum; supports "includes any of" operator (multi-select)

### Smart List Purpose Logic (revealed by filters + description)
The Warm/Bi-Weekly smart list is defined as:
- Stage is in [Warm stage(s)] (Filter 5: "Stage includes any of: B - Warm...")
- AND (Last Text Sent > 14 days ago OR Last Sent Email > 14 days ago OR Last Call > 14 days ago) — [INFERRED: the three activity filters likely have OR logic, meaning contact who hasn't had ANY of these in 14 days]
- AND Tags do NOT include any of the compliance/exclusion tags (removes litigators, do-not-contact, bouncers, realtors, broker-recruits)

The empty state (0 results) means: all warm-stage contacts have either been contacted within 14 days, OR have been filtered out by tags.

### Enum Values
- **Stage prefix pattern:** "B - Warm..." suggests stages are prefixed alphabetically (A, B, C, etc.) for ordering
- **Tag namespaces observed:** `compliance:`, `tcpa:`, `contact:`, `audience:`

### Non-Obvious Logic to Implement

1. **Smart List vs Collection Items:** Collections (Pipeline) are groupings of smart lists with emoji icons chosen per-list. Smart Lists in the "SMART LISTS" section all use the same funnel icon. The first section's items can have custom emoji.

2. **"No people found" + bulk action icons:** The toolbar always renders the action icons in the same row as the result count. With 0 results, icons appear but should be disabled/non-functional.

3. **Filters (N) button as toggle:** Clicking opens/closes the filter panel as a right-side slide-in or push panel. The count N is the number of active filter conditions (not the number of tag values within a single filter — 5 here = 5 separate filter conditions).

4. **Tag filter operator "any" link:** The word "any" in "exclude any" is an inline toggle link. Clicking it switches to "all" (changing OR logic to AND logic for the tag set). This is an unusual UX — a clickable word within a sentence that changes filter semantics.

5. **PIPELINE type badge:** The badge next to the list name indicates what "type" of smart list this is. "PIPELINE" = belongs to a Pipeline collection (stage-based). Other types might be "SMART LIST" or unlabeled.

6. **Column sort state:** Two columns show sort indicators simultaneously — Stage has ▼ and Last Communication has ↑. This may be a primary+secondary sort, or ▼ on Stage is just the default indicator for a sortable column while ↑ on Last Communication indicates it's the ACTIVE sort. Implementation: likely one active sort at a time, the other arrow is just the "available to sort" affordance.

7. **"Out Of State Home ..." segment dropdown:** This appears to be a SAVED VIEW/SEGMENT that can be layered onto any list independently of the smart list's own filters. This creates a two-level filtering model: Smart List filters (permanent, define the list) + Segment/View filters (temporary, applied per session or saved as a named view).

8. **Update List button:** This is a SAVE action for the smart list definition — it persists the current filter panel state as the canonical definition of this smart list. The workflow is: edit filters in the panel → click Update List to save.

9. **Left rail badge pills:** Counts use "K" suffix for thousands (7K, 12K, 17K, 1K). They are right-aligned in the row with a fixed-width badge pill. The currently selected item does NOT show its count (the badge disappears when selected).

10. **Empty left rail badge for "New Leads: No Call Attempt":** No badge visible — could be 0 results or the badge only renders for counts > 0.

11. **Resize handle:** A drag handle at the bottom of the left rail (the small horizontal bar visible at the very bottom) suggests the left rail height or the overall panel is resizable.

12. **URL pattern:** `/2/people/list/30` — account ID is `2`, list ID is `30`. All smart lists are accessible by numeric ID.
